description: ECHOES: Beyond the Mission is a NASA Space Apps 2026 project led by a 17-year-old student from Peru. I am currently its sole member, learning web development as I build an interactive bilingual experience. Using verified NASA sources, the project will tell the stories of equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, highlighting the science and people behind each mission. summary:
ECHOES: Beyond the Mission is a bilingual, interactive educational experience developed by a 17-year-old student from Peru for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, inspired by the challenge "Abandoned but Not Forgotten."

The project brings to life the legacies of four historic space explorers: the Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle, Surveyor 3, Spirit, and Ingenuity.

Through authentic NASA archival photographs, interactive 3D planetary visualizations, scientific timelines, emotional storytelling, and educational minigames, visitors embark on an immersive journey across the Moon and Mars.

Each explorer shares its story through six narrated scenes, combining documented scientific facts with clearly identified fictional personification. Visitors discover scientific achievements, complete interactive challenges, recover four symbolic memories, and unlock an emotional cinematic finale.

Developed using web technologies with transparently disclosed AI assistance and bilingual synthetic narration, ECHOES aims to make space science more accessible, engaging, and memorable.

Our message is simple: Not every explorer returns home, but every discovery leaves a legacy.

From Peru to the universe.
details:
ECHOES: Beyond the Mission — Project Details

1. Project Overview

ECHOES: Beyond the Mission is an immersive, bilingual educational website independently developed by a 17-year-old student from Peru for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Inspired by the challenge "Abandoned but Not Forgotten," the project explores the scientific achievements and enduring legacies of four historic space explorers: the Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle, Surveyor 3, Spirit, and Ingenuity.

Its central purpose is to transform historical space missions into meaningful, accessible, and emotionally engaging learning experiences.

2. How It Works

Visitors begin their journey through an interactive planetary environment featuring Earth, the Moon, and Mars.

The experience contains four individual chapters, each divided into six narrated scenes. Through authentic NASA archival photographs, historical timelines, interactive visualizations, and fictional first-person storytelling, visitors discover each explorer's accomplishments, challenges, and final moments.

Each chapter includes an educational minigame inspired by its mission. Visitors can explore additional scientific facts, replay activities, and collect symbolic memories.

Recovering all four memories unlocks an emotional cinematic finale celebrating the lasting contribution of these explorers to humanity.

The experience is available in English and Spanish, with synthetic narration, optional subtitles, background music, and interactive controls.

3. Technology and Development

ECHOES was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and is publicly hosted through Netlify.

Its interactive features include animated planetary representations, 2.5D visual effects, responsive interfaces, browser-based minigames, audiovisual storytelling, and locally stored progress.

Artificial intelligence assisted with programming, writing, and visual development. Bilingual synthetic narration was generated using the open-source Kokoro text-to-speech model.

AI-assisted content is disclosed, and fictional narratives are explicitly distinguished from historical NASA documentation.

4. Scientific Foundation

The project incorporates publicly available NASA mission records, scientific information, and authentic archival photography.

Historical facts are supported by identifiable sources. Creative dramatizations are used for educational storytelling and are not presented as actual spacecraft communications.

5. Innovation and Educational Impact

ECHOES combines science, interactive storytelling, emotional engagement, and gamification into a unified educational experience.

Instead of presenting space exploration exclusively through technical information, it encourages visitors to connect with the stories behind scientific achievements.

Its bilingual and browser-based design aims to reach students, educators, and curious audiences worldwide without requiring specialized equipment or software installation.

The project was developed with particular attention to scientific accuracy, accessibility, visual storytelling, and responsible AI disclosure.

6. Final Message

ECHOES reminds us that exploration is not defined only by reaching new worlds, but also by the knowledge and inspiration left behind.

Not every explorer returns home. But every discovery leaves a legacy.

From Peru to the universe.
